name: Asakura Motoi
source:
A cheerful sportsman and mood maker of the first class. He's a kind brother who hates lies and deceit, but loves events.

He has a strong desire to protect his family and friends. Known by others for his caring personality, he often takes unfavorable roles.

Currently, he's worried about his younger sister who has a crush on Nao.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/motoi.html]official wesbite[/url]]
